episodeTitle.en: How to drive word of mouth | Nilan Peiris (CPO of Wise)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何驱动口碑传播 | 尼兰·皮里斯（Nilan Peiris，Wise首席产品官）

guestBioOfficial.en: Nilan Peiris is Chief Product Officer at Wise, one of the fastest-growing (and profitable) tech companies in the world. Wise allows anyone to send money in more than 60 currencies to over 160 countries at low cost, and throughout its history has grown primarily through word of mouth. In today’s episode, we discuss: • Tactical advice on driving word of mouth (WOM)
guestBioOfficial.zh: 尼兰·皮里斯（Nilan Peiris）是Wise的首席产品官，Wise是全球增长最快（且盈利）的科技公司之一。Wise允许用户以低成本向全球160多个国家汇款，并主要通过口碑传播实现用户增长。在本期节目中，我们将探讨：• 推动口碑传播的实用建议（WOM）
